Web check of 2026-07-27, searched in the country's own language. Taken up again after too hasty a first reading. Value kept at 0 and status disputed. The Belarusian State Academy of Arts in Minsk is a state institution and did carry a Puppet Theatre Actor specialism: the encyclopaedic entry read dates the first intake to 1975 and a second, by distance learning, to 1987. A search summary further asserts the course is still active, on site and by distance. That assertion did not survive checking: the two admissions portals consulted and read list, at specialism level, only Acting and Theatre Directing, with no visible puppetry stream. This does not prove the course is gone, since the Belarusian system distinguishes the specialism from the stream within it and these portals do not descend to the second level; it proves only that no accessible source establishes it. Counting 1 would mean inferring from a 1975 intake the existence of a course in 2026, which the indicator's known bias forbids. The previous value of 1 was in any case an estimate made without research. To be checked by a route that reaches stream level: the ministry's official catalogue of specialisms, or direct contact with the academy's admissions board. The least satisfactory file in this pass.

establishments.award: Puppetry stream not confirmed: admissions portals list only Acting and Theatre Directing
establishments.description: The Belarusian State Academy of Arts enrolled its first puppet acting cohort in 1975 and a distance-learning cohort in 1987. Whether the stream still runs could not be established: published listings stop one level above where the answer would be.

observations.reasoning: DISPUTED. First value produced as a mean conditioned on artists who actually tour, which drops from the denominator the makers who do not perform. Method error identified: a fee is not a performance. For France the true median probably sits between 10 and 20, over a bimodal distribution. For countries with permanent companies, recomputed from the top: 250 to 400 performances a year, casts of 3 to 5, a company of about twenty, so on the order of 50 to 90. To be redone in full once the denominator is settled.
